description: Find variant records by variant set, reference sequence, or genomic region (start/end, 0-based inclusive / exclusive per the BrAPI spec; servers may differ). results[] holds the leading matches up to loadLimit and a 24,000-byte budget; when it holds fewer rows than matched, the matched set is materialized as a dataframe — read it with brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

extraFilters.description: Extra BrAPI filters forwarded verbatim. Valid keys vary by endpoint; brapi_describe_filters enumerates them. Named params on this tool take precedence on conflict.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline in results[]. Omit for the deployment default. results[] also stops at a 24,000-byte budget, whichever bound comes first, and keeps at least one row when any matched. When results[] holds fewer rows than matched, the matched rows are staged in a dataframe (marked truncated if the upstream walk stopped short); query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

name: brapi_find_variants

appliedFilters.description: Filter map sent upstream (named filters plus extraFilters).

cap.description: The effective loadLimit when truncated; shown is below it when the 24,000-byte inline budget bound first (notice says which).

dataframe.description: The matched rows, staged as a dataframe when results[] holds fewer.

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

maxRows.description: Row cap that ended the pull, present only when that cap fired.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Upstream-reported row total, when known; can exceed rowCount.

truncated.description: True when the dataframe holds less than the upstream reports: a cap, failed page, deadline, or short upstream ended the pull, or it was skipped. warnings says which. Absent otherwise.

distributions.description: Value frequency per field across every matched row fetched.

referenceName.description: Reference sequence name → count of variants on that reference.

variantSetDbId.description: Variant set ID → count of variants in that set.

variantType.description: Variant type → count of variants of that type.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_not_found`: An uncaught BrAPI data request answered HTTP 404. `upstream_rate_limited`: An uncaught BrAPI data request exhausted retries after HTTP 429. `missing_find_route`: Neither the GET list nor a usable POST search route is advertised. `search_endpoint_disabled`: Only a POST search route marked unusable by the active dialect is advertised. `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. `all_filters_dropped`: The active dialect dropped every filter the agent supplied — the upstream server does not honor any of the requested scope filters on this endpoint, so the call would silently widen to the unfiltered baseline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when more rows exist beyond the returned set.

notice.description: Why results[] is empty, or which bound cut it short and the dataframe holding the matched rows.

refinementHint.description: Suggested refinement when the result set is large.

results.description: Leading matched variant rows, up to loadLimit and a 24,000-byte budget, whichever binds first.

alternateBases.description: Alternate alleles observed at this position.

filtersApplied.description: True when QC filters were evaluated on this variant.

filtersFailed.description: IDs of QC filters this variant failed, when any.

filtersPassed.description: True when the variant passed all QC filters.

referenceBases.description: Reference allele sequence at the variant position.

variantNames.description: Known names / aliases for this variant.

anyOf.description: Variant-set FK array — a variant may belong to multiple sets.
Field present but null on the upstream.

variantSetDbId.description: FK to the variant set(s) this variant belongs to. May be a string or string[] depending on server.

variantSetDbIds.description: Plural-form FK array per BrAPI v2.1 spec, when the server uses it.

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the server, else the rows scanned.

truncated.description: True when results[] holds fewer rows than matched because loadLimit or the inline byte budget bound.

warnings.description: Advisory messages (filter overrides, partial data, capability gaps).
